name: optiq-loop
description: Applies source changes ROCm Optiq proposed and you approved, then rebuilds - the editor half of the profile, edit, profile again loop.

optiq.buildCommand.markdownDescription:
Shell command that rebuilds this workspace, run from the first workspace folder. Optiq runs it after a change you approved and reads the output back, so a compile error becomes the assistant's next fix.

The file that was just edited is exported as `$OPTIQ_FILE` (workspace-relative), `$OPTIQ_STEM` (its name without extension) and `$OPTIQ_DIR`. Use them when the project builds many independent targets, or a command naming one target will happily rebuild the wrong thing.

Examples: `cmake --build build`, or `hipcc -O3 generators/$OPTIQ_STEM.cpp -o build/$OPTIQ_STEM`.
